## Mod Information

###### Mode: Summoners Rift & Aram

###### Author: Leischii & NekoHiko

###### Mod version: 4.0.1

###### Description: Enables Gangplank announcer on Summoners Rift and Aram. There is also an alternative version including the Bilgewater background music.

## Installation

To use this mod you have download 2 files:

1\. Either "Gangplank Announcer Base" OR "Gangplank Announcer Base + Music"

2\. A language addon . Do NOT use the "base" mod and the "base + music" mod in combination!

(If your announcer is mute you are missing a langauge addon.)
